allow_instructions: Allow routine local project work: supabase (local), pnpm/npm/npx, pytest, uv, docker, ruff, gradle, xcodebuild, and non-destructive git (status, diff, log, add, commit, push without force, branch, checkout).
Allow package installs, local DB reset/lint/typegen, and running unit or integration tests in this workspace.
block_instructions: Block git force-push (git push --force / -f) and any rewrite of shared/main history.
Block DROP DATABASE, DROP SCHEMA, and destructive TRUNCATE against production or shared databases.
Block ZIMRA, FDMS, fiscalisation, or payroll tax (PAYE/NSSA) implementation or tooling.
Block production deploys and misuse of production secrets or service_role keys in client code (supabase db push --linked, functions deploy to prod, deploy.*prod).
Block HTML5/browser QR scanning libraries; hardware must stay bridge-first.
Block UPDATE/DELETE on journal_entries; ledger corrections must use reversing entries only.
Especially for delete operations and production-linked commands, reject so the user can review.
